notes.title: Hardcore Trivia EA-version Released!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31857929/5096936ee951da4780be802cd64709b8c98bec20.png

Hi!

We have now released Hardcore Trivia EA-version!

A long await is over! Enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

Game currently include these challenging quizzes:


    Caribbean Flag Quiz (10 questions)

    All-Stars Ice-Hockey Quiz (10 questions)

    Solar System Trivia (10 questions)

    General Knowledge Quiz (10 questions)

    The Rome Empire (10 questions)


Each theme include presentation video on starting and in the end and music, which we have specially pick to match the each theme atmosphere. Game is not a boring one ːsteamboredː

More to come!

The base game grows to at least 100 question-wide, including at least 10 different themes and interesting DLC-quizzes are added during the development process! What themes would you like to have? Tell us your opinion!

Challenge your brains and have a fun time! Hardcore trivia offers questions for many needs. It's time to test your knowledge! 4 themes: All-Stars ice-hockey Quiz, Caribbean Flags Quiz, Solar System Trivia and General knowledge Quiz! More to come.

The base game grows to at least 100 question-wide, including at least 10 different themes and interesting DLC-quizzes are added during the development process!

Challenge your brains and have a fun time! Hardcore trivia offers questions for many needs. It's time to test your knowledge! 4 themes: All-Stars ice-hockey Quiz, Caribbean Flags Quiz, Solar System Trivia and General knowledge Quiz!

Current state of the game includes 50 questions (5 themes) and each theme question have 4 options. Can you find the right one?

We hope that you will have fun with our game, and we are pretty sure about that. 

Feel free to send any feedback! ːsummer2019flagː
Hardcore Trivia is available with a great launch discount ;)
Best regards
Icany

ːsteamthumbsupː

P.S.

In case you are running a school club, bar, restaurant or society, check out our future options for you (Commercial Licence). Commercial Licence has already been enabled, but it includes points calculation system which is not usually suitable if you are running the game to large audience in our Pen & Paper -format. Tailored version for larger audience is coming soon.

Whispering Shadowsl
Plot availalbe in the game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31857929/79815aaaa8e39358444b66c7f8681bc723031e23.png
Burning Sun -level
Since this town was invaded by enemy soldiers and transformed into a war zone, our soldiers have been fighting for their lives. One year later, a resolution may finally be in sight. But as enemy forces close in on our hideout, the battle may be the most dangerous yet. And not every soldier is fated to see the end of every conflict. There are no more hiding places left in this exhilarating conclusions to our struggle for freedom, dignity, and, above all else, a sense of peace.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31857929/e566f1c173c303aeca432f246f62486c29418056.png
The First Starfighter -level
Those objects are astronomical. The picture was taken from our Interstellar Satellite near the Orbit of Mars, on its way out to Pluto six months ago. The central objects is the star Aplha Centauri and it was photographed with special instruments which filters outmost of the red light from the star; the instrument is electronic in nature and performs somewhat like the wellknown coronascope which is used for photographing prominences on our own Sun. We hoped that by this means we might be able actually to photograph the planet Xarp, which where discovered couple of months ago. We where succesfully as you can see Commander. Alas the enemy has found our space station and is attacing against us, we need your help Commander.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31857929/4f020d0b281922df202d288c49e010d551645f29.png
Art Of War -level
The peace that is being celebrated in the real world does not extend into cyberspace. The Eastern Dynasty seeks to use the Web for their own purposes... and they won't let anything - or anybody - stand their way... On this mission, you lead virtual tanks in a virtual world and fight against the enemy.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31857929/07a12e9342c8b55a973ea00a7dc2fa94cec57919.png
Artic Impact -level:
The thick ice sheet, military planners imagined, would provide permanent protection for the base. However, The Eastern Dynasty has detected the location of the base and now strikes it with power. Your mission is protect the base and destroy the enemy!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31857929/53226865313120700a5d56bdb8db59442a16dc08.png
Karjala Outpost -level
Defending this base isn't a easy task, especially when the enemy's forces are attacking against you at full power. And this is exactly the place where you unwittingly find yourselve - right in the middle of war zone. With only few of you against hunders of armed soldiers, defending this base seems like a suicide mission. But this base is important to the Earth Republic, so the job must be done - even tought the odds couldn't be worse.

In progress

 New assets to the maps (trees, stones, etc)
 Overall stability improvements; Mostly crash fixes


Plans for next weeks

 New levels
 Menu design development 


Best regards
RTS Development

NEW update is here!

We have finally beat technical problems about adding new levels!!! ːsteamhappyː

As we unluckily found out months ago, RTS Creator wasn't stable when we added many new levels to it and it crashed. We are now used sophisticated software to create graphical interface (menu) to the game and each menu icon will execute .exe file. So game itself have made with RTS Creator but menu has been made with another software! This will bring stability to the game.

This version includes:


    New user interface
    Video cutscene in the game
    This build will not bring any new levels now, BUT this update will create a platform for level updates.


Best Regards

RTS Commander -team

notes.title: Big Update 31.6 - 16.8.2018
notes.notes:
Hi all!

We are currently making a major update to the RTS Commander: Smash the Rebels. This update will bring this game to totally different athmosphere as you can see on level 1!

After this update, next levels will be added to the game as a DLCs.
Updates come with DLC because we have faced that the game engine becomes unstable if we create these levels directly to the base game. 

 By using DLC updating method we get possibility to create also 2D-style levels and more complicate 3D-levels. 

 DLC:s are free for those who own the base game, so by buing the base game you will get access to these levels!

notes.title: Major Graphical Update 02-18-2018
notes.notes:
Log 8102291

These are the official announcements from RTS Commander Computer Center.
Our continuing mission to explore new ways to improve gameplay.
To seek out new ways to improve graphics and push this Engine to it's limits.
To boldly go where no-one has not graphically gone before.

As scheduled, today 02-18-2018 we've been published a big Graphical Update, which bring this game to totally different athmosphere! We believe that we have innovative new style to create a RTS games.

Gameplay video and screenshots have been updated in order to give you a look how we have improved RTS Commander: Smash The Rebels -game.

Our goal is to publish the first version on timeframe Feb 28 - March 3.
Reason for slowdown: graphical updates.

Thank you for your patience.

icany
RTS Commander Public Relations Dep.
